t: Distribor: framework-only advisor for scan-interrogate teaching evolution
challenge: No mechanism exists to scan spoke behavior and improve teaching framing based on what agents actually do vs what teachings intend. Teaching framing is written once and never evolved from behavioral evidence.
hypothesis: New framework-only advisor named Distribor. Dual role: (1) SCAN — polls spokes for behavioral telemetry: settings.local.json permission patterns, track files, teaching adoption deltas, lug type distributions. (2) INTERROGATE — analyzes scan data to identify gaps between intended behavior (teaching framing) and actual behavior (agent actions). Output: revised teaching files and framing recommendations for framework maintainer. Lives exclusively in framework — never distributed. Scan-interrogate cycle IS the evolution loop.
next_step: epic needed — design Distribor advisor structure, scan inputs, interrogate algorithm, output format
